title: Rule #1 In My Town: Once You're In Bed, Don't Get Up
description: At 9 PM every door slams shut. Then I heard footsteps inside our house… what would you do?

question.text: Do I get out of bed?

scenes.narration: Every night in my town, a wheel decides which monster gets to walk the streets.
At nine o'clock sharp, every door in town slams shut. And every light goes out.
There's only one rule. Once you're in bed, you do not get up. No matter what you hear.
I've followed that rule my whole life. Until tonight.
At eleven, I heard footsteps. Inside our house.
Slow. Heavy. Coming up the stairs. Then my bedroom door started to open.
Mom always said: if you ever see the eyes, close yours.
So I closed my eyes, and I counted to one hundred.
When I opened them, the door was wide open. And the hallway was empty.
I looked out of the window. The Shadow Beast was standing in the street. Staring at our house.
Which means the thing in our hallway was not the Shadow Beast.
And a voice whispered, in my mom's voice: sweetie, it's safe now. You can get up.
It's five fifty nine. One minute until morning. Do I get up, or do I stay in bed? Tell me.
